from_speaker: turn out to be incremental advances
our_interpretation: The plain reading contrasts extraordinary capability promotion with releases that improve existing capabilities without delivering the implied transformation.
Godlike is rhetorical; it does not require a promoter to use that exact word.
GPT-5 is a clear contextual example, but the plural statement covers an unspecified set of releases over several years.
The historical period ends at the post. Its start remains unspecified rather than imposing an arbitrary meaning of several years.
Incremental does not mean useless or incapable of substantial improvements on individual tasks.
criteria.support_condition: Matched promotional records and independent evaluations show that the relevant releases delivered bounded improvements within existing capabilities rather than the extraordinary changes promoted.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The corresponding releases demonstrably delivered the promoted qualitative capability changes, making the incremental characterization inaccurate across the claimed scope.
